The purpose of this notebook will be to calculate the upper bound costing of three 

Step 1: Calculate HIV metrics
* Calculate HIV acquisitions, deaths, PY on ART, PY off ART + error bars

Step 2: Calculate DALY-relevant metrics
* Calculate DALYs + error bars
* Calculate number of all interventions + error bars

Step 3: Perform Costing Analysis


# Setup

## Load Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
library(magrittr)
library(rsample)
```

## Define constants

```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64

# DALY calculation parameters
discount_percent = 0.03
discount_start_year = 2025
infected_weight = 0.274
art_weight = 0.078

# Costing

CET = 500
ppyOnART = 210
```

## Define functions

These are functions for confidence interval calculations

```{r}
bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

calculate.CI.by.metric = function(data, scenario.name, metric, n = 500){
  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name), times = n)
  
  bt_resamples$mean.metric <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, metric)
  metric_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.metric, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  return(
      data.frame(
      scenario_name = scenario.name, 
      metric = metric,
      metric.mean = mean(bt_resamples$mean.metric),
      metric.lb = metric_95[[1]], 
      metric.ub = metric_95[[2]]
    )
  )
}

format_sig3 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(val) > 0 & abs(val) < 1) {
      formatC(signif(val, 3), digits=3, format="fg", flag="#")
    } else {
      formatC(round(val), format="d")
    }
  }, character(1))
}
```

```{r}
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>%
```

## Calculate basic metrics

* HIV acquisitions
* HIV deaths
* person-years on ART
* person-years off ART

### AYA

```{r}
time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya <- inspire.test.results %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year < 2046, Age >= 15, Age < 25) %>% 
  mutate(Year = ceiling(Year) - 1) %>% 
  group_by(Year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population*pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum( ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor), 
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor), 
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = PLHIV - On_ART) 

time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya %>% write_csv("basic_metrics_A1525.csv")

time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya %>%
  mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(Year - discount_start_year) ) %>%
  mutate(On_ART.discount = On_ART * discount_factor,
         ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount = ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * discount_factor,
         PrEP_INSPIRE.discount = PrEP_INSPIRE * discount_factor,
         OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount = OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * discount_factor)

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated.aya %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART), 
            On_ART.discount = sum(On_ART.discount),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART),
            ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
            ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE),
            PrEP_INSPIRE.discount = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE.discount),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount),
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya <- data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya %>% merge(
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya %>% filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
    select(sim.ix, 
           Newly.Infected.baseline = Newly.Infected,
           Died_from_HIV.baseline = Died_from_HIV,
           On_ART.baseline = On_ART, 
           On_ART.discount.baseline = On_ART.discount, 
           Off_ART.baseline = Off_ART),
  by = c("sim.ix")
) %>% 
  mutate(Newly.Infected.diff = Newly.Infected - Newly.Infected.baseline,
         Died_from_HIV.diff = Died_from_HIV - Died_from_HIV.baseline,
         On_ART.diff = On_ART - On_ART.baseline,
         On_ART.discount.diff = On_ART.discount - On_ART.discount.baseline,
         Off_ART.diff = Off_ART - Off_ART.baseline) %>% 
  mutate(Newly.Infected.pct = Newly.Infected.diff/Newly.Infected.baseline,
         Died_from_HIV.pct = Died_from_HIV.diff/Died_from_HIV.baseline,
         On_ART.pct = On_ART.diff/On_ART, 
         On_ART.discount.pct = On_ART.discount.diff/On_ART.discount, 
         Off_ART.pct = Off_ART.diff/Off_ART)

metric.names = c(
  "Newly.Infected",
  "Died_from_HIV",
  "On_ART",
  "On_ART.discount",
  "Off_ART",
  "Newly.Infected.diff",
  "Died_from_HIV.diff",
  "On_ART.diff",
  "On_ART.discount.diff",
  "Off_ART.diff",
  "Newly.Infected.pct",
  "Died_from_HIV.pct",
  "On_ART.pct",
  "On_ART.discount.pct",
  "Off_ART.pct"
)

scenario.names = c("baseline", "art", "prep", "zaimara")

metrics.A1525 = data.frame()

for (i in metric.names){
  for (j in scenario.names) {
    
    #print(c(i,j))
    h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = j,
      metric = i)
    
    metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)
  }
}

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "art",
      metric = "OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "art",
      metric = "OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "prep",
      metric = "PrEP_INSPIRE")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "prep",
      metric = "PrEP_INSPIRE.discount")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "zaimara",
      metric = "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045.aya,
      scenario.name = "zaimara",
      metric = "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount")
metrics.A1525 = rbind(metrics.A1525, h)

metrics.A1525 %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = metric, names_from = scenario_name, values_from = metric.mean)

metrics.A1525 %>%  write_csv("basic_metrics_with_CIs_A1525.csv")

```

## Generate table of results

Calculate DALYs for each individual run

```{r}
data_by_age_year <- inspire.daly.results %>%
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
     Infected = sum(Infected),
     On_ART = sum(On_ART),
     pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
     .groups = "drop_last"
   )

data_by_age_year$Year_Integer <- floor((data_by_age_year$Year-0.5))

m2 <- data_by_age_year %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
          Infected = mean(Infected),
          On_ART = mean(On_ART),
          pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
          .groups = "drop_last"
         )

m2 <- m2 %>%
        mutate(On_ART_calib = On_ART*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_calib = Infected*pop_scaling_factor,
        Died_from_HIV_calib = Died_from_HIV*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_off_ART_calib = (Infected - On_ART)*pop_scaling_factor)

life_expectancy = 80
m2$Age <- ifelse(m2$Age >life_expectancy, life_expectancy, m2$Age)

m3 <- m2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
      dplyr::select(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix, 
                    Died_from_HIV_calib, Infected_off_ART_calib, On_ART_calib) %>%
      dplyr::summarise_all(list(median=median))

disability.tibble <- m3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    infected_untreated = sum(Infected_off_ART_calib_median),
    on_art = sum(On_ART_calib_median)
    ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year_Integer)

m4 <- m3 %>% mutate(year_applied = Year_Integer - (Age - (life_expectancy + 1)))

daly.tibble <- merge(
  tibble(scenario_name_ = scenario.names),
  tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ),
  all = TRUE
) %>% 
  merge(  tibble(sim.ix = seq(1,10)), all=TRUE)

daly_expanded <- tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ) %>% 
  crossing(
    sim.ix = unique(m4$sim.ix),
    scenario_name = unique(m4$scenario_name)
  )

yll <- daly_expanded %>%
  left_join(m4, by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")) %>%
  filter(Year_Integer <= year, year_applied > year) %>%
  group_by(year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(
    yll = sum(Died_from_HIV_calib_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daly = left_join(
  yll, 
  disability.tibble, 
  by=c("year", "sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
 replace(is.na(.), 0)

daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly = infected_untreated*infected_weight + on_art*art_weight + yll)
daly <- daly %>% mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(year - discount_start_year) )
daly[daly$year < discount_start_year,'discount_factor'] <- 1.0
daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly_future_discounted = daly*discount_factor )

# Intermediate table!
HIV.DALYs <- daly %>% select(
  Year = year, 
  scenario_name,
  sim.ix,
  HIV.DALY = daly,
  HIV.DALY.discounted = daly_future_discounted)

HIV.DALYs %>% write_csv("INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")
```

## Generate confidence interval calculations
Aggregate and calculate total DALYs averted
```{r}
HIV.DALYs <- read_csv("INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")
# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 
  
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == 'baseline') %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted
  )

```

Then, calculate total DALYs averted and estimate confidence intervals

```{r}
metric.names = c("HIV.DALY", "HIV.DALY.discounted",
                 "HIV.DALY.diff", "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff",
                 "HIV.DALY.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted.pct")

scenario.names = c("baseline", "art", "prep", "zaimara")

daly.cis = data.frame()

for (i in metric.names){
  for (j in scenario.names) {
    
    #print(c(i,j))
    h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = HIV.DALYs.agg,
      scenario.name = j,
      metric = i)
    
    daly.cis = rbind(daly.cis, h)
  }
}

daly.cis

daly.cis %>% write_csv("INSPIRE_CE_DALY_calculation_CIs.csv")

```

## AYA
```{r}
A1525.dat <- merge(
  metrics.A1525 %>% pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "scenario_name",
    names_from = "metric",
    values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub"),
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
  daly.cis %>%  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "scenario_name",
    names_from = "metric",
    values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub")
  ) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
  by = c("scenario_name")
)

A1525.cost.threshold.calculation <- A1525.dat %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         mean_On_ART.diff, mean_On_ART.discount.diff,
         mean_HIV.DALY.diff, mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff,
         mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer, mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount,
         mean_PrEP_INSPIRE, mean_PrEP_INSPIRE.discount,
         mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE, mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount) %>% 
  mutate(
    undiscounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      mean_PrEP_INSPIRE == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_PrEP_INSPIRE != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_PrEP_INSPIRE),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_PrEP_INSPIRE.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_PrEP_INSPIRE.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_PrEP_INSPIRE.discount),
    ZAIMARA.cost = case_when(
      mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
    ZAIMARA.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount)
  )
  
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         ART.cost, ART.discount.cost,
         PREP.cost, PREP.discount.cost,
         ZAIMARA.cost, ZAIMARA.discount.cost)
```

```{r}
    by = c('sim.ix')

  mutate(
```

```{r}
    undiscounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      ART.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      ART.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/ART.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      PrEP_INSPIRE == 0 ~ 0,
      PrEP_INSPIRE != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/PrEP_INSPIRE),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      PrEP_INSPIRE.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      PrEP_INSPIRE.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/PrEP_INSPIRE.discount),
    ZAIMARA.cost = case_when(
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE == 0 ~ 0,
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
    ZAIMARA.discount.cost = case_when(
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/ZAIMARA_INSPIRE.discount)
  )

#A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging

A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs <- data.frame()

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "art",
      metric = "ART.cost")
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "art",
      metric = "ART.discount.cost")
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "prep",
      metric = "PREP.cost")
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "prep",
      metric = "PREP.discount.cost")
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "zaimara",
      metric = "ZAIMARA.cost")
A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(A1525.cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)
```

# Generate tables for slide deck

## All ages
```{r}
metrics.A1599 %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("Newly.Infected", "Died_from_HIV", "On_ART", "Off_ART")) %>% 
  mutate(
    formatted = sprintf("%.0f (%.0f, %.0f)", metric.mean, metric.lb, metric.ub)
  ) %>%
  select(scenario_name, metric, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = formatted
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-scenario_name, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% 
   pivot_wider(names_from = scenario_name, values_from = value)

metrics.A1599 %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("Newly.Infected.diff", "Died_from_HIV.diff", "On_ART.diff", "Off_ART.diff")) %>% 
  mutate(
        formatted = sprintf( "%s (%s, %s)",
      format_sig3(metric.mean),
      format_sig3(metric.lb),
      format_sig3(metric.ub)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(scenario_name, metric, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = formatted
  )

metrics.A1599 %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("Newly.Infected.pct", "Died_from_HIV.pct", "On_ART.pct", "Off_ART.pct")) %>% 
  mutate(
        formatted = sprintf( "%s (%s, %s)",
      format_sig3(metric.mean),
      format_sig3(metric.lb),
      format_sig3(metric.ub)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(scenario_name, metric, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = formatted
  )
```
